result:
The audit warning on `POST /api/posts` is fixed. Typecheck passes, my two API token tests pass, and `bunx guren audit` reports 0 failures. Its one remaining warning is an unrelated `katex` dependency advisory.

`this.authorize()` returned 403 on bearer requests, because the gate only knows the session user and a bearer request has none. So `ApiPostController.store` in `app/Http/Controllers/Api/PostController.ts` now loads the token's owner and runs `PostPolicy.create` on them directly. It throws `AuthorizationException.deny('Post')` if the policy refuses. I put a `// guren-audit-ignore` comment above the action giving that reason.

I did not rerun the full `bunx guren gate` after this change.
